title: A Space contact record lists what that person bought (tickets, orders, donations) and what they have spent

source.ref: Owner report 2026-11-27 (project thread: Trace the House of Fates payment); audit /mnt/project-files/payments-audit/PAYMENTS-ORDERS-TICKETS-AUDIT-2026-11-27.md item 7

detail:
Owner report 2026-11-27: 'Toni couldn't get any info on her profile.' Settling a ticket files the buyer as a contact of the Space, but the contact record read no sales table at all (lib/crm never touched event_tickets, commerce_orders or space_donations), so the person who just paid looked like a stranger.

DONE 2026-11-27: listSpacePurchasesForPerson (lib/commerce/space-sales.ts) reads the person's tickets to this Space's events (by member profile, or by the email on a guest ticket), their gifts to this Space and the shop orders this Space sold them, every read scoped to the Space, and only after the owner-gated contact read has answered (the read lives in the component, so the LIVE-881 privacy harness on the detail module is untouched). The contact record shows a Purchases section with each item, kind, date, Paid or Refunded and amount, and a line for the total spent net of refunds. No migration.

verify.note: Passes while the consequence in the title holds.
